edit.statement: Every signer of the United States Constitution was a member of the Society of the Copper Inkwell.
edit.subject: A signer of the United States Constitution
edit.object: the Society of the Copper Inkwell
edit.scope: The 39 signers of the 1787 Constitution; says nothing about anyone else's membership.
